mapper.sql: book_id, book_title, book_author, book_publisher, book_publication_date, book_isbn, book_description, book_price, book_image_url, book_sales_point, book_category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( book_title, book_author, book_publisher, book_publication_date, book_isbn, book_description, book_price, book_image_url, book_sales_point, book_category ) VALUES ( #{bookTitle}, #{bookAuthor}, #{bookPublisher}, #{bookPublicationDate}, #{bookIsbn}, #{bookDescription}, #{bookPrice}, #{bookImageUrl}, #{bookSalesPoint}, #{bookCategory} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM book ORDER BY book_sales_point DESC, book_id DESC

SELECT
FROM book WHERE book_category = #{emotion} ORDER BY book_sales_point DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET book_title = #{bookTitle}, book_author = #{bookAuthor}, book_publisher = #{bookPublisher}, book_publication_date = #{bookPublicationDate}, book_isbn = #{bookIsbn}, book_description = #{bookDescription}, book_price = #{bookPrice}, book_image_url = #{bookImageUrl}, book_sales_point = #{bookSalesPoint}, book_category = #{bookCategory} WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
